totals.note: 2024: imports fell 15% to $8.8bn, exports fell 7% to $10.3bn; France, the UK and Germany took 56% of imports and 41% of exports; China 13% of exports (4th destination). 2025 (2026 report): imports $9.9bn, +13%; exports down 1% in value (no dollar figure given).

caveats.t: Customs figures are values declared at the border by the reporting economy, not sales. Mirror rows disagree: the UK declares US$1.44bn of HS 97 exports to the US for 2025 while the US declares US$1.63bn of imports from the UK; Switzerland declares US$813m of exports to the US while the US records US$188m of imports from Switzerland; Hong Kong declares US$464m of exports to the UK while the UK records US$8.3m of imports from Hong Kong. Goods in transit, consignment moves, valuation rules and declaration points explain the gaps; the globe should show which side reported each arrow.
